title: Anderson Attachable Handle – Anderson Attachable Handle Assembly, Non-electrified
description: Attachable® handle for 400 Hz ground power connectors. Designed to protect the power connector Impervious to jet fuel, Skydrol®, glycol, water, and other aircraft fluids Light weight (2lbs/1kg) and exceptional impact characteristics No control boxes required for cable assembly Optional switches Replaceable, weatherproof switches control ground power and the cable retriever at the connector Used as a convenient hand grip for engaging and disengaging, reducing strain on the connector during handling
